summary: PostBlockingSettles fc refuted at every frame class and every fuel, answering the residual docstring's open question in the negative. The plan's pre-declared output-branch repair was landed with its direction lemma and then rejected by the anti-weakening gate on decided evidence (labelFreeSaturatedExit_not_of_saturateBlocked_inr, postBlockingExitSettled_false, noUnblockedFreshWork_iff_of_labelFreeSaturatedExit). Under explicit orchestrator ruling, the narrowed repair PostBlockingSettlesRun fc fuel was then landed -- the residual restricted to a branch some expandBranchWithFuel call returned open, at that call's own fuel, the same narrowing ArmSettlement already uses. Its Phase 6 gate PASSED: buildTableauAt_isSome_of_settlesRun is the bridge the output-branch design could not build, eight terminus restatements land on it, and buildTableauAt_isSome_of_budget_of_run certifies each is a strengthening. Non-vacuity is proved for the pass doing real work and #guard_msgs-checked for the full antecedent on seed runs. C9 entries 22, 23 and 24.

blockers: PostBlockingSettlesRun is CARRIED, not discharged. It is a hypothesis exactly as ArmSettlement is; whether it holds at the terminus's own fuel figure is open and nothing decides it in either direction. Register entry 24 exists so the narrowing is not mistaken for a proof. This is why the task closes PARTIAL.

Eight of the twenty-two terminus restatements landed (the four family roots and their four caller-facing seed forms). The remaining fourteen are _lengthBudget / signedUniverse substitutions, each a one-line application of its family root, with the recipe recorded in Phase 6's Reasoned Exclusions.
The seed-run half of the non-vacuity witness is a #guard_msgs-checked measurement rather than a kernel proof, because expandBranchWithFuel is compiled by well-founded recursion.

Across fourteen formula shapes, four frame classes and three fuel figures, buildTableauAt's own guard never fired -- the threaded tracker and the recomputed armTracker agreed everywhere -- so no probed run exercised the post-blocking arm. A fact about the probe's reach, not about the residual.
